description: Hi, I’m Shahriar, leader of Globe Guardians. We’re building Shake Station: a snow-globe Mars outpost game where players spend Sun Coins on oxygen, food, heat and shielding to keep astronaut Pip alive through storms and solar flares. We’re six (dev, UI/UX, AI, research, video) and need a game dev, NASA data fan, educator, illustrator and tester. Beginners welcome! Shake the globe. Survive the sky.
